system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: a unified, operator-level simulator that predicts LLM training and inference performance so configurations can be explored without cluster profiling

components.name: Input Description
components.role: left flank: Native Model (Hugging Face, vLLM, Custom PyTorch logos) + System Config (GPU/NPU info, interconnect, parallelism plan)

components.name: Graph-based Frontend
components.role: model information + configuration -> graph generation (Linear, Matmul, Scale, Softmax) -> graph manipulation -> graph execution producing a trace

components.name: Multi-engine Backend
components.role: operator simulator with profiling, prediction and analytical (computation / communication) engines joined by a fused engine, plus an op overlap processor

components.name: Design Explorer
components.role: design parameters as a search tree pruned by a rule-based pruning tool

components.name: Simulation Results
components.role: right flank: simulation summary (latency, flops / MFU, memory, power), timeline trace (single layer, 3D), design exploration (best config)

content.key_idea: One platform turns a native model plus a system config into an operator graph, simulates every operator with the cheapest accurate engine, and searches configurations by pruning.
content.reading_order: Left flank inputs -> frontend (top-down inside) -> backend -> design explorer -> right flank outputs.

palette.used_for: grey header bars (model information, operator simulator ground, design parameters, op overlap processor, fused engine)
frontend stage grounds, rule-based pruning tool

style.stroke: dark ink ~0.6 pt on every box; a black ~1.3 pt frame around the whole figure
style.font: Calibri Bold throughout, 6-7 pt at print size; bullets for output lists
style.arrows: few, short, thick black arrows between flanks and core; tree edges as plain black lines
style.icons: framework logos, topology / list line icons, a document icon, mini node-link graphs, mini timeline bars

encoding.color_means: fill = engine / stage identity (blue profiling, peach prediction, mint analytical, grey structural headers), reused in the frontend, backend and later figures
encoding.emphasis: no accent colour; the core is singled out by its size, its frame and its title under the frame
reusable_patterns: flank-core-flank overview inside a thick outer frame, flank titles above, subsystem titles below
grey header bar at the top of each subsystem
output list as bold bullets plus one tiny glyph per output
weaknesses: dense: about 60 text runs in a 470 pt strip

evidence: our unified all-in-one simulator for LLM training, inference and design-space exploration
ingests native models such as HuggingFace, vLLM, or customized PyTorch models

summary: A double-column overview framed in black: on the left the input description (native model from Hugging Face, vLLM or PyTorch, and a system config of GPU/NPU info, interconnect and parallelism plan); in the middle the Charon Simulation Platform with three equal subsystems -- graph-based frontend, multi-engine backend and design explorer; on the right the simulation results (summary metrics, timeline traces, best configuration).
summary_zh: 双栏总览图，整图套粗黑框：左边是输入（模型来源和系统配置），中间是 Charon 平台的三个等宽子系统（前端、后端、设计探索器），右边是输出（指标汇总、时间线、最优配置）。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon'.
